description: Experiment 1, open loop (spec section 6.1): one truth run per seed, recorded under every architecture of the list. The seed list is written here before any run (docs/prompts/20 Step 4). At least 20 seeds (A103, the minimum in data/scenarios/evaluation/default.json), neutral integers, none date-shaped (00 section 2 item 2). The list is a plain list of integers chosen by hand; it is not a function of any result.
